description: Sentence syntax similarity, adjacent sentences, mean
notes: Regression test against the old set-based implementation. Both sentences should contain the same (dependency, POS) label set, but NK/ADJ is attached to SB/NOUN in sentence 1 and to OA/NOUN in sentence 2. The old set representation could therefore return 1.0. In the new structural tree comparison each tree has 7 nodes, the maximum common tree has 6 nodes, so 6 / (7 + 7 - 6) = 0.75.
